fill(cap: int, xs: List[int], var n: int) uses nondet =
  let (tx, rx) = Channel[int](cap)
  for x in xs
    tx.try_send(x) else return
    n += 1

accepted(cap: int, xs: List[int]) -> int uses nondet =
  pre cap > 0
  post out >= 0
  post out <= cap
  post out <= xs.len()
  ex accepted(2, [1, 2, 3]) == 2
  ex accepted(5, [1, 2]) == 2
  ex accepted(3, []) == 0
  var n = 0
  fill(cap: cap, xs: xs, n: &n)
  n
